contact.mapQuery: Thai Jasmine Rice, 1552 Whiskey Road, Aiken, SC 29803
contact.hoursNote: The kitchen closes 30 minutes before closing time. Parties of 8 or more, please reserve.

hero.eyebrow: Authentic Thai food on Whiskey Road
hero.title: Noodles, curries *and Thai tea*
hero.lede: Delicious, fresh Thai dishes, with walk-ins welcome and orders by phone or DoorDash. Choose your heat, from mild to Thai hot.

sections.title: The *menu*
sections.intro: Stir-fried dishes are served with jasmine white rice. Choose tofu, mixed vegetables, chicken or pork, or substitute shrimp or beef.

items.name: Spring rolls (5)
items.desc: Cabbage, carrots and yellow beans in a wonton wrapper, with sweet chili sauce

items.name: Fish cakes (5)
items.desc: Tilapia patties with red curry paste and green beans, with sweet chili sauce

items.name: Goong Hum Pah (5)
items.desc: Shrimp stuffed with ground pork, green onion and sesame oil in a wonton wrapper

items.name: Dumplings (5)
items.desc: Steamed or fried, with marinated chicken, cabbage and green onion, and ginger sauce

items.name: Thai meatballs (8)
items.desc: In a special sweet and sour sauce

items.name: Fried tofu
items.desc: With Thai sweet vinegar peanut sauce

items.name: Tom Yum
items.desc: Lemongrass broth with mushrooms, tomatoes, onion, scallions and chili

items.name: Tom Ka
items.desc: Coconut milk, galangal, tomatoes, onion, scallions and lime

items.name: Wonton
items.desc: Stuffed with ground pork, green onion and lettuce

items.name: Pad Ka Prow
items.desc: Sweet basil, onions, bell peppers and Thai chili in a brown sauce

items.name: Sweet and Sour
items.desc: Bell peppers, pineapple, baby corn, mushrooms, tomatoes, carrots and onions

items.name: Pad Ped
items.desc: Bamboo shoots, string beans and bell peppers in curry paste

sections.footnote: Prices from the restaurant's current menu, with tofu, vegetables, chicken or pork; to be confirmed. Orders are taken by phone and DoorDash only.

sections.title: Hungry? Call it in.
sections.text: Phone lines are busiest at rush hour, so call a little early if you can.
